//: Config for tests under tests/ (the nearest tsconfig for Vitest's transform). Inherits the app's compilerOptions (notably jsx: react-jsx). include covers tests/ AND ../src so the transform applies automatic JSX to imported src components too (not just in-test components). Tests are NOT part of the app's `tsc --noEmit` typecheck (separate config). Feature tests in ../src/features/<feature>/tests/ are covered by the ../src include; exclude is reset so the app config's exclude of them is not inherited.
